overview.description: The Baillie Gifford Emerging Markets ETF (BGEG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund actively invests in all-cap stocks of companies located in emerging or frontier markets. Stocks are selected based on fundamental analysis and weighted based on conviction. BGEG was launched on Jun 2, 2026 and is issued by Baillie Gifford Funds.
